marks.q: A return to profitability: adjusted EBITDA profit of not less than £0.6m (FY25: £1.9m), compared to a first half adjusted EBITDA loss of £1m, reflecting benefit of cost reductions
Pipeline growth has improved as Q1 has progressed, although trading remains challenging despite a number of significant contract opportunities that have carried over from FY26
Full year revenues are now expected to be circa £25m with an underlying EBITDA loss in the range of £1.2m to £1.5m.

lines.text: Oct-25: “The Group continues to trade in line with the Board's expectations” → Oct-26: no expectations anchor at all; full-year guide replaced by a loss range
lines.span: Board's expectations given at H1 TU Oct-22, Oct-25 and H1 R Dec-25 → first H1 update without it

lines.text: Jun-26: “current expectations are that by 31 March 2027, the Group will be in a net cash position” → Oct-26: net debt £1.6m, only “retains adequate liquidity”

Membership revenue quantified: “Overall membership revenue is anticipated to be around £2.9m” (Apr-26), “some £3.5m in total” (Jun-26) → Oct-26 membership unquantified; “recurring license revenue is expected to be £2.1m” given instead
